verdict.rationale: Recruitee documents its own job-board publishing mechanism: an XML feed generated per job board that carries every published job, so one posting can fan out to the boards. The evidence never names LinkedIn, Indeed, or specific aggregators, and nothing shows sponsored or paid-post management inside the ATS. Missing for 10: named LinkedIn/Indeed/aggregator integrations, sponsored-post budgeting and management in the ATS, independent or hands-on corroboration of multiposting.

support.subject: As a recruiter, one posting fans out to the job boards — LinkedIn, Indeed, and the aggregators — with sponsored-post management from inside the ATS

citations.quote: This documentation describes how Recruitee structures data for publishing job offers on job boards.
Feed is available as XML file and is generated per job board. ... All currently published jobs are visible in the feed.
